newsitem.title: FRANCE: France plans to tax satellite TV channels.
newsitem.headline: France plans to tax satellite TV channels.

text.p: Satellite TV channels are to be taxed to boost French subsidies for the film and broadcasting industries, said Marc Tessier, managing director of the Centre National de la Cinematographie (CNC), the state body which manages the subsidies.
"It was not possible to maintain a situation in which certain channels were taxed and other were not," he told a news conference over the weekend at the MIP television trade fair in Cannes.
French thematic satellite channels will be liable to pay a tax of between 1.2 percent and 5.5 percent of their turnover from subscriber revenue from January 1, 1988, he said.
